Pinterest Setup, Pins and Strategy

Pinterest Management Services: What They Include

By Marie Glow StudioPublished August 3, 2026Updated September 26, 2026

If you've wondered what someone managing your Pinterest actually does month to month, here's the honest breakdown. Pinterest management services cover research, content planning, pin creation, publishing and performance review, repeated every month so the account can build visibility steadily over time.

What happens in a typical month of Pinterest management?

A month of management follows five steps, and the last one feeds the next month.

  1. Set goals tied to useful pages. Each month starts with what you want promoted, such as a product, a collection, a blog post or a course page.
  2. Plan keywords and campaigns. That covers evergreen content and seasonal topics, with the lead time seasonal pins need built in.
  3. Create fresh, branded pin variations. The pins use your colors, fonts, logo and photos, with new angles so the feed is not one image repeated.
  4. Schedule steady publishing. Pins go out consistently and are spread across your pages, so no single URL gets flooded.
  5. Review and carry the lessons forward. The month ends with a look at what performed, and the findings shape the next plan.

What do Pinterest management services include at Marie Glow Studio?

Every tier of Monthly Pinterest Management includes account management, keyword research and content planning; custom branded pin graphics with SEO titles and descriptions; alt text, SEO-friendly filenames and UTM tracking; destination-link review and recommended board placement; Pinterest and Tailwind scheduling, board maintenance and broken-link monitoring; a monthly analytics review; one revision round; and email support. What do you need to provide for Pinterest management?

You bring the material worth promoting: products, services, blog posts or landing pages, plus your seasonal priorities and your brand colors, fonts, logo and photos. The work also needs access to your Pinterest business account and, depending on the setup, Shopify, your website, scheduling tools or Canva. Secure collaborator or delegated access is used whenever the platform supports it.

An existing Pinterest business account is required, because your analytics and Pinterest's business features depend on it. If you have none yet, begin with Pinterest Business Account Setup and add management afterward.

Which mistakes get in the way of a Pinterest management service?

  • Starting before the basics are ready. Missing information or account access can delay when the work begins.
  • Expecting a quick verdict. The service recommends a runway of three to six months, so a judgment after the second week says little.
  • Leaving out seasonal priorities. They are part of what you are asked to supply, and planning around them starts with you.
  • Sending pins to a website that is not ready. Visitors need a working, useful destination on the other end.

Planning pitfalls, such as a schedule nobody can keep, are covered in how to create a Pinterest content calendar.

How long does Pinterest management take to show results?

Plan on three to six months before judging the results, and remember that no Pinterest specialist can honestly guarantee specific rankings, clicks or sales. Pins reach people on different schedules, so consistency matters more than any single month. For a fuller timeline, read how long Pinterest SEO takes.

What should you look for in a Pinterest scheduling tool?

If you run Pinterest yourself, pick a scheduler by how well it fits your routine: can you prepare a batch in one sitting, and can you see afterward which pin went to which page? Management clients do not need one, because scheduling is part of the service.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a Pinterest business account before hiring a management service?

Yes. A business account gives access to analytics and Pinterest business features. If you do not have one yet, Pinterest Business Account Setup comes first, and management can follow.

Is Pinterest management a long contract?

No. Monthly Pinterest Management is month to month with no minimum commitment, although three to six months is suggested to see real traction. Payment is billed in advance and is non-refundable once work begins for that month.
